stable.notes: Saved-meeting follow-ups, reviewed Work follow-ups and clickable evidence. Sonnet defaults for fresh Meeting Ask settings; existing choices preserved. Fact check checks public claims with readable sources under explicit public-topic consent. The matched complete companion 635 includes the offline phone transcription model, local memory search and a steady status row. Experimental transcription and automatic cues remain off. Comparisons of public costs are of limited use; phone and Android acceptance is still pending. Signed and notarized by Apple.

whatsNew.summary: Shorter, grounded Meeting Ask answers and a Fact check button. Pairs with server 6.71.12 and the complete companion 6.10.635.

sections.title: Ask during or after a meeting
items: Ask follow-ups on saved meetings and review an answer as linked Work with its source.
Fresh settings default to Sonnet; existing explicit model choices survive. Draft and grounding review use the selected model.
Answers preserve useful summary context and distinguish reported labor from verified time saved.

sections.title: Check a public claim
items: Fact check seeks a readable source under the existing public-topic opt-in. Private meeting details stay out of public queries.
Inline citations open their evidence. A source that was not read cannot establish a verified claim.
Comparisons of public costs remain of limited use; no invented average or overpricing ratio.

sections.title: Complete companion 635
items: 635 includes the offline phone transcription model, text from phone files and images, local memory keyword search, a steady meeting status row and sturdier Android pairing.
Experimental transcription and automatic cue flags stay disabled. Stable transcription is unchanged.
Phone, G2 and Android acceptance is still pending; no claim of better raw transcription.

notice.title: Right-click the pet
notice.body: Right-click the pet for Full motion, Calm motion or No motion, or to hide it. Hidden, it comes back from COS Control in the menu bar, under Session pet. The pet also shows Codex threads while they work and Cursor chats mid-turn.
